meta.parties: Sideris Et Al. v. Simon Et Al

rules.statement: In the absence of an ouster or something equivalent, a co-owner cannot initiate a prescriptive title by any secret intention in his own mind.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is open to the Court, from lapse of time in conjunction with the circumstances of the case, to presume that a possession originally that of a co-owner, has since become adverse."
